The practical details

Social media
package FAQs

What counts as a short-form video?+

One professionally edited video of up to 60 seconds, created using footage captured during filming sessions or supplied by the client. Cross-posting the same video to different platforms does not count as additional videos.

What counts as a branded post or carousel?+

A single-image graphic, photo post or carousel of up to 5 slides, including a caption.

What counts as a Story placement?+

One individual Story frame, published to Instagram and/or Facebook.

Are revisions included?+

Yes. One round of reasonable revisions is included per deliverable. Additional revisions may incur extra fees.

Is filming included?+

Yes. All packages include on-site filming within the agreed Ottawa service area. Additional filming sessions or travel outside the service area may incur extra fees.

Do you guarantee followers, engagement or leads?+

No. We focus on producing professional content, maintaining a consistent presence and improving performance through ongoing analysis. Specific audience growth or business results cannot be guaranteed.

What are the contract terms?+

Packages require an initial three-month commitment, followed by month-to-month service. Payment is due at the start of each billing month. The founder’s offer takes 15% off your first two months; regular package pricing applies from month three. All prices are CAD per month, including taxes.

Are advertising costs included?+

No. Paid advertising budgets, creator fees and third-party expenses are separate from the monthly management fee.

Is creator outreach guaranteed to result in collaborations?+

No. Partner includes outreach to up to five relevant creators or potential collaborators monthly, but responses, participation and resulting collaborations are not guaranteed.
